name: Oliver Farrel
description: Icatian priest who killed Tymolin after she refused him.

description_citations.text: "Tymolin Loneglade". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Following the fall of Trokair, Farrel and his followers formally break their ties with the rest of Icatia.
timeline.quote: After the fall of Trokair, Farrel and his followers formally broke their ties with the rest of Icatia.

citation.text: Farrel's Zealot (Fallen Empires, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Farrel's followers become vigilantes battling Icatians and followers of Tourach.
timeline.quote: Farrel and his followers became a formidable band of vigilantes, battling Icatians and followers of Tourach.

citation.text: Farrel's Zealot (Fallen Empires, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Oliver Farrel whips Montford into a frenzy against the Ebon Hand and appoints Sianna as his champion to slay Tymolin.
timeline.quote: Farrel then appoints Sianna to be his champion bestowing his mantle upon her.

citation.work: Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Volume 1: Rumors of War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Farrelites ambush Tev and Tymolin; Tev summons a Wall of Bone, disenchants Farrel's mantle and escapes with a Darkness spell, but the siblings are separated.
timeline.quote: Not recognizing Tev to be a powerful planeswalker the blood cult attacks the pair ignoring him.

citation.work: Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Volume 1: Rumors of War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vaylesh captures Tymolin and lures the Farrelites to the Ebon Hand camp; Farrel stabs Tymolin to death when she refuses him.
timeline.quote: Refusing his request, Tymolin is stabbed to death by Farrel while still tied up.

citation.work: Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Volume 2: Nations Asunder". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sensing her death, Tev transforms into a dragon-like Tevesh Szat and incinerates Vaylesh, Oliver and Sianna and their forces.
timeline.quote: Tev now Tevesh Szat soared in incinerating the thrull and all present including Vaylesh, Oliver, and Sianna.

citation.work: Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Volume 2: Nations Asunder". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oliver Farrel and the Farrelites attack Tev and Tymolin; Tev disenchants Sianna's cloak and Tymolin is separated from him.
timeline.quote: Oliver Farrel and his Farrelites attacked Tev and Tymolin.

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat", section "Transformation to Tevesh Szat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tymolin is captured by Vaylesh and the Ebon Hand and stabbed to death by Farrel.
timeline.quote: which backfired when Farrel stabbed Tymolin to death.

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat", section "Transformation to Tevesh Szat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sensing his sister's death, Tev fully transforms into a serpentine dragon form and incinerates the Ebon Hand encampment, killing Sianna, Farrel and Vaylesh.
timeline.quote: Tev incinerated everyone present, including Sianna, Oliver Farrel, and Vaylesh.

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat", section "Transformation to Tevesh Szat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mabel, on her birthday in Goodhill, is pressed by Mayor Oliver to bring out her family relic.
timeline.quote: Perhaps this would be an appropriate occasion to bring out that old relic you have tucked away in your attic

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 1: Calamity Comes to Valley
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 1: Calamity Comes to Valley" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Jenefer reports a stranger in Pond Creek, and Mabel grabs her rapier.
timeline.quote: "There's a stranger in Pond Creek, and she don't look well at all."

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 1: Calamity Comes to Valley
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 1: Calamity Comes to Valley" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: The collapsed Helga tells Mabel she was attacked by a Calamity Beast, and Mabel takes her home.
timeline.quote: "Attack … Calamity Beast …"

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 1: Calamity Comes to Valley
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 1: Calamity Comes to Valley" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Helga tells Mabel, Clem and Oliver about Maha's attack and the destruction of Pondside, but Oliver doubts her.
timeline.quote: Your imagination seems a touch overactive, which is to be expected of an artistic temperament.

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 2: An Expected Party" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Oliver reassures the guests that Calamity Beasts do not trouble Valley, while Helga recalls the history of weavers and Lily of the Valley.
timeline.quote: The unpredictable ones, the Blight Snake and the Drought Cat and so on, don't intrude on the affairs of us little folk in Valley.

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 2: An Expected Party" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: At the lively birthday party Helga appears in the doorway and Oliver gives his speech praising Mabel.
timeline.quote: "Neighbors—nay, friends," Oliver began

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 2: An Expected Party" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Mabel publicly defends Helga, announces she will go to Pondside, and reveals the fang-sword, which sheens with flame.
timeline.quote: a faint sheen of flame rippled along the carved tooth from hilt to tip.

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 2: An Expected Party" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: The returning heroes are welcomed with a parade in Goodhill, and Oliver gives another speech.
timeline.quote: treating their arrival as an impromptu parade.

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 5: Nightfall in Fountainport" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Helga arrives in Goodhill and Clem fetches Oliver and has Rosalyn make tea.
timeline.quote: fetching Oliver , the mayor, and ensuring that Rosalyn prepared mint tea to soothe Helga

citation.text: "Clem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tymolin Loneglade is murdered in a ritual sacrifice by Oliver Farrel.
timeline.quote: Tymolin Loneglade was murdered by the zealot Oliver Farrel

citation.text: "Fall of the Sarpadian Empires", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oliver Farrel breaks from the Order of Leitbur, gathering followers with speeches against the Icatian government.
timeline.quote: Farrel gathered many followers through impassioned speeches on the street

citation.text: "Farrelites", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Farrel ambushes Tymolin and Tev; Tev dispels the mantle from Sianna and is then lost in Havenwood, letting Tymolin be captured.
timeline.quote: Tev dispelled the mantle from Sianna, defeating and angering Farrel

citation.text: "Farrelites", section "Death of Farrel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Farrel kills Tymolin after she refuses to be his champion and lover.
timeline.quote: Farrel killed her, sending Tev into a rage.

citation.text: "Farrelites", section "Death of Farrel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tev arrives as Tevesh Szat and incinerates the Farrelites and Ebon Hand, killing Farrel and Sianna.
timeline.quote: incinerating all present, including Farrel and Sianna

citation.text: "Farrelites", section "Death of Farrel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oliver pressures Mabel at her birthday party to display Cragflame, but she deflects him.
timeline.quote: he subtly pressured her to display Cragflame

citation.text: "Oliver", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mabel takes charge of the situation when a stranger in distress arrives, outpacing Oliver.
timeline.quote: Oliver hurried to investigate but was soon overtaken by Mabel, who took charge of the situation.

citation.text: "Oliver", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oliver laughs off Helga's account of the Night Owl and Pondside's destruction and returns to the festivities.
timeline.quote: Oliver laughed off her account, attributing it to an overactive imagination due to her artistic nature.

citation.text: "Oliver", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Outside, Oliver reassures villagers there is no need to worry about Calamity Beasts.
timeline.quote: he reassured the villagers that there was no need to worry about Calamity Beasts

citation.text: "Oliver", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: When the heroes return to Goodhill, Oliver gives an embellished speech to the crowd.
timeline.quote: Oliver seized the opportunity to address the gathered crowd with a passionate and embellished speech.

citation.text: "Oliver", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oliver breaks from the priesthood, finding the Order too lenient with the Ebon Hand, and gathers followers who become the Farrelites.
timeline.quote: Oliver broke away from the priesthood because he found the Order too lenient

citation.text: "Oliver Farrel", section "Formation of the Farrelites". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tymolin rejects Oliver to live with her dwarven lover Kaylen.
timeline.quote: Tymolin rejected Oliver to live with her Dwarven lover Kaylen

citation.text: "Oliver Farrel", section "Leading the Farrelites". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oliver gives Sianna his mantle as champion and tries to kill Tymolin with his Aeolipile; Tev kills several members and disenchants the mantle.
timeline.quote: Tev responded with fury killing several members and disenchanting the mantle off of Sianna.

citation.text: "Oliver Farrel", section "Loss of the Mantle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oliver stabs Tymolin to death after she refuses to rejoin him.
timeline.quote: when she refused stabbed her to death

citation.text: "Oliver Farrel", section "Martyrdom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tev, newly transformed as Tevesh Szat, incinerates everyone present including Oliver and Sianna; the Farrelites consider them martyrs.
timeline.quote: Enraged at his sister's death, Tev appeared as the newly transformed Tevesh Szat

citation.text: "Oliver Farrel", section "Martyrdom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vaylesh captures Tymolin Loneglade and lures Oliver Farrel to combat to draw the Farrelites into the open.
timeline.quote: Vaylesh , a priestess of the Order of the Ebon Hand, captured Tymolin Loneglade

citation.text: "Order of the Ebon Hand", section "Encounter with the Farrelites". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Farrel kills Tym; Tev Loneglade kills all the troops with a Fireball and transforms into Tevesh Szat.
timeline.quote: When Farrel killed Tym, the planeswalker Tev Loneglade killed all the troops present with a massive Fireball .

citation.text: "Order of the Ebon Hand", section "Encounter with the Farrelites". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
